title: Brush Essentials Makeup Brush Gift Set with Travel Case
descriptionHtml:
✓ Vegan✓ Clean + Planet Aware✓ Cruelty-Free

What it is: A limited-edition gift set with three essential brushes for effortless application and a seamless finish.


What Else You Need to Know: Intentionally crafted with cruelty-free bristles, 100% aluminum handles, and straightforward design, these three brushes are created to help you achieve a polished look without any effort. Use The Big Brush for gel and cream formulas, The Double Brush for concealer and blush, and with The Fluffy Brush for creams and powders.


Set Contents:

- The Fluffy Brush for Targeted Powders

- The Big Brush for Buffing

- The Double Brush Sculpting Brush

How to Use+

Suggested Usage:

-Use The Big Brush to buff and blend gel and cream formulas like Glowy Super™ Gel Lightweight Illuminator and Slip Tint™ Tinted Moisturizer.

-Use the small end of The Double Brush for concealer like Slip Tint™ Concealer, use the large end for blush like Dew Blush™.

-Use The Fluffy Brush for pinpointed powder application like Slip Tint™ Setting Powder.
